title: 游戏系统缺乏深度与平衡
description: 多个游戏系统（如经济、战斗、社交、建造）缺乏深度或平衡性，导致玩法单调、选择无意义或难度失衡。
evidence: very harsh balance where you'll grind heavy objects and sell them to get a very necessary tool at the beginning
none of it is properly balanced
How am I supposed to afford the 8 kg of helium my reactor chews through every single ♥♥♥♥♥♥ minute?

evidence_items.quote: não parece ser possível construir algo/colocar uma tarefa de construção num lugar onde um dos seus tripulantes não está vendo
evidence_items.description: 建造机制受限于视野，无法在船员看不到的地方放置建造任务，导致建造速度变慢。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 似乎无法在你的某位船员看不到的地方建造东西/放置建造任务

evidence_items.quote: most of the skills in the games r not even implemented yet so there is no reason to choose them in character creation
evidence_items.description: 许多技能未实装，导致角色创建时选择无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里的大部分技能甚至都还没实装，所以在角色创建时根本没有理由去选它们

evidence_items.quote: these gun skills r not even implemented in the game. and they r not even acquirable during the game. weird right? if u shoot a lot enough, u should be able to hit something at some point. but player keep shooting themselves even with the gun skill
evidence_items.description: 枪械技能未实装，玩家射击时仍会打到自己
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这些枪械技能甚至都没在游戏里实装。而且在游戏过程中也根本学不到。很奇怪对吧？如果你开枪开得足够多，总该在某个时候能打中点什么吧。但玩家即使有枪械技能也一直在打到自己

evidence_items.quote: The progression is off. You can stay around the starting area and pretty much find (almost) all types of shipparts and machines.
evidence_items.description: 进度失衡，在起始区域就能找到几乎所有类型的飞船部件和机器，可能破坏后期乐趣。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 进度曲线不对劲。你可以待在起始区域附近，就几乎能找到（几乎）所有类型的飞船部件和机器。

evidence_items.quote: every single gameplay system is disjointed and lacking polish
evidence_items.description: 各游戏系统彼此脱节且缺乏打磨
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每一个游戏系统都支离破碎、缺乏打磨

evidence_items.quote: Especially the fire hazard at the starting stage is just... a mess still.
evidence_items.description: 起始阶段的火灾危害机制设计混乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尤其是起始阶段的火灾隐患，还是……一团糟。

evidence_items.quote: Making stations is nearly untenable
evidence_items.description: 建造空间站几乎不可行
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造空间站几乎难以为继

evidence_items.quote: 技能系统和战斗系统属于根本没有
evidence_items.description: 技能系统和战斗系统基本不存在
evidence_items.quote_zh: 技能系统和战斗系统属于根本没有

evidence_items.quote: Things are unnecessarily complicated; it really needs a redesign.
evidence_items.description: 系统过于复杂，需要重新设计
evidence_items.quote_zh: 事情被搞得没必要地复杂；它真的需要重新设计。

evidence_items.quote: 战斗根据天赋来要么疲劳攻击到高二氧化碳要么三拳打死镇关西
evidence_items.description: 战斗根据天赋要么疲劳攻击到高二氧化碳要么三拳打死敌人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗根据天赋来要么疲劳攻击到高二氧化碳要么三拳打死镇关西

evidence_items.quote: 拆船拆出来的部件一般占地巨大，塞不进储物箱船上也没地放
evidence_items.description: 拆船部件占地巨大，塞不进储物箱船上也没地放
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拆船拆出来的部件一般占地巨大，塞不进储物箱船上也没地放

evidence_items.quote: I have encountered almost no emergent environmental hazards during routine derelict exploration that actually require diagnosis, preparation or adaptation.
evidence_items.description: 常规探索中几乎不会遇到需要诊断、准备或适应的突发环境危害
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在常规的废弃飞船探索中，我几乎没有遇到过真正需要诊断、准备或适应的涌现性环境危害。

evidence_items.quote: The core loop of exploring derelicts becomes repetitive, largely risk-free and lacking in tension.
evidence_items.description: 探索废弃飞船的核心循环重复且缺乏紧张感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 探索废弃飞船的核心循环变得重复、基本没有风险，并且缺乏紧张感。

evidence_items.quote: Shipbreaking itself is generally uneventful: choose the appropriate interaction and wait for something to be dismantled, repaired or removed.
evidence_items.description: 拆船过程平淡无奇，只需选择互动并等待
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拆船本身通常平淡无奇：选择适当的交互方式，然后等待某物被拆解、修理或移除。

evidence_items.quote: Floor and wall strength barely matter. Weight is the only value that counts.
evidence_items.description: 地板和墙强度几乎无影响，只有重量有意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。

evidence_items.quote: Relatively little part variation. There is a lot of equipment, but each piece has one job. You rarely get competing tiers
evidence_items.description: 零件种类少，每件只有单一功能，缺乏竞争性层级
evidence_items.quote_zh: 部件种类相对较少。设备很多，但每一件只有一个用途。你很少能遇到相互竞争的等级

evidence_items.quote: tasks run line by line, top-down or bottom-up, instead of nearest-next
evidence_items.description: 任务队列按行扫描而非就近执行，导致大量无效走动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务按行执行，自上而下或自下而上，而不是就近下一个

evidence_items.quote: then they put on all these entirely unrelated game mechanics that someone playing a salvaging game likely doesn't want or need, and it just stops being even remotely fun
evidence_items.description: 加入与打捞玩法无关的机制导致游戏失去乐趣
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后他们又加上了所有这些完全无关的游戏机制，而玩打捞游戏的人很可能既不想要也不需要这些，于是它就变得连一丁点乐趣都没有了

evidence_items.quote: I'm not sure why I need a mod to assign an automated task to pick up items into a character's inventory
evidence_items.description: 需要模组才能分配自动拾取物品到角色物品栏的任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不明白为什么我需要一个模组才能指派一项自动任务来把物品拾取到角色的物品栏里

evidence_items.quote: You can't rely of autotask because it will leave holes or for some reason bounce from one corner of the work area to the other furthest corner and leave holes and gaps everywhere
evidence_items.description: 自动任务会留下孔洞或在工作区对角间跳跃，留下缝隙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你不能依赖自动任务，因为它会留下空洞，或者不知为何从工作区的一个角落弹到另一个最远的角落，到处留下空洞和缝隙

evidence_items.quote: The game can be kind of repetitive, especially in the early game where you're just scrapping ships
evidence_items.description: 游戏早期重复性高，主要是拆解船只。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏可能会有点重复，尤其是在前期你只是在拆解飞船的时候

evidence_items.quote: Dialogue and recruitment is kind of weird
evidence_items.description: 对话和招募系统感觉奇怪。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话和招募有点奇怪

evidence_items.quote: the game got pushed out of early access with only a quick bug fixing pass over a game whose features are mostly jank that either poorly interacts with the core game, or outright gets in the way of what little fun there is to have
evidence_items.description: 游戏在仅快速修复bug后便脱离抢先体验，功能大多与核心玩法互动不良或妨碍乐趣
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏被推出了抢先体验阶段，只对游戏做了一轮快速的bug修复，而这款游戏的功能大多是破烂玩意儿，要么与核心玩法互动不良，要么直接妨碍了那仅有的一点乐趣

evidence_items.quote: the other 75% was half baked, poorly realized jank that could best be explained as a placeholder while the game is fleshed out
evidence_items.description: 游戏四分之三的核心内容半生不熟、实现糟糕，像占位符
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另外75%则是半生不熟、实现糟糕的破烂玩意儿，最好的解释就是在游戏完善过程中充当占位符

evidence_items.quote: Ein bisschen überflüssig finde ich in einem solchen spiel social-moods.
evidence_items.description: 社交情绪系统在游戏中显得多余
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我觉得在这样一款游戏里，社交情绪有点多余。

evidence_items.quote: The worst thing about this game is badly designed game loop.
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环设计糟糕，赚钱后金钱失去价值，缺乏目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏最糟糕的地方在于设计糟糕的游戏循环。

evidence_items.quote: 情绪系统和社交系统，这俩我玩了一会真看不出来现版本有啥用
evidence_items.description: 情绪和社交系统在现版本中看不出有什么作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 情绪系统和社交系统，这俩我玩了一会真看不出来现版本有啥用

evidence_items.quote: once you understand the basic mechanics, the gameplay loop falls apart abruptly. There isn't much of a game here.
evidence_items.description: 理解基本机制后游戏循环迅速崩塌，内容不足
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你理解了基本机制，游戏循环就突然崩塌了。这里并没有多少游戏内容。

evidence_items.quote: Hand to hand combat desperately needs an update
evidence_items.description: 徒手战斗手感差，需要更新
evidence_items.quote_zh: 徒手格斗迫切需要更新

evidence_items.quote: a lot of gameplay systems serve little purpose
evidence_items.description: 许多游戏系统几乎没有作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大量玩法系统几乎毫无用处

evidence_items.quote: Рутина. Да, хоть я и похвалил за сборку, но тут буквально разбор ради разбора, чтобы получить деньги, но ради чего?
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环是例行公事，为了钱而拆解，但目的不明确。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 例行公事。是的，虽然我夸过拆解组装，但这里简直就是为拆而拆，为了赚钱，可为了什么呢？

evidence_items.quote: Мало компонентов. Опять же мир риса: Начал с лука - закончил энерговинтовкой, но до неё более десятка разного выбора. А тут: Двигатель от жиги или премиальная PUMP♂♂♂. Типа просто черное и белое и так почти со всем
evidence_items.description: 组件很少，只有黑白分明的选择，几乎一切都如此。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 组件太少。还是拿《边缘世界》来比：从弓开始——最后到能量步枪，但在这之前有十几种不同的选择。而这里：要么是日古利发动机，要么是高级PUMP♂♂♂。就像非黑即白，几乎一切都这样。

evidence_items.quote: Everything takes AGES to do, it's one of those games you can just leave running and go do something else
evidence_items.description: 游戏中的一切都需要很长时间，可以放着不管去做其他事。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 做任何事情都要花上好久好久，这是那种你可以直接让它挂着运行、自己去做别的事情的游戏。

evidence_items.quote: a person can be dying right infront of you and there is no way to interact with them. There are all those traits, all those needs, those dialogue options. But all of them do absolutely nothing.
evidence_items.description: NPC濒死时无法互动，所有特质、需求和对话选项都无效。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个人可能就快死在你面前，而你却没有任何办法与他们互动。有那么多特质，那么多需求，那么多对话选项。但它们全都毫无作用。

evidence_items.quote: It lacks depth
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏深度，部分区域细节过多而其他区域细节很少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它缺乏深度

evidence_items.quote: gemi customizationu hayla çok zayıf
evidence_items.description: 飞船自定义功能仍然很弱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船自定义仍然非常薄弱

evidence_items.quote: It's repetitive and you really have to like the concept of doing something again and again
evidence_items.description: 游戏重复性高，缺乏挑战
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它很重复，你真的必须喜欢一遍又一遍做同一件事的概念

evidence_items.quote: a lot of features seem half baked
evidence_items.description: 许多功能半成品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很多功能似乎都半生不熟

evidence_items.quote: the social combat is convoluted and doesn’t even matter in the end anyways
evidence_items.description: 社交战斗系统复杂且最终无关紧要
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交战斗既晦涩难懂，到最后也根本无关紧要

evidence_items.quote: there's not a lot to do
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容少，可做的事情不多
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没多少事可做

evidence_items.quote: You use the same nav console that EVERYONE USES. There is only one. You use the exact same thruster, so on and so forth.
evidence_items.description: 飞船部件缺乏多样性，导航控制台等只有一种
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你使用的是每个人都用的同一个导航控制台。只有一个。你使用的是完全相同的推进器，诸如此类。

evidence_items.quote: The one upgrade path, that is somewhat fully developed is the one that is about structure cutting. You go from a hacksaw, to an angle grinder, to a laser torch. Everything else? 2 or even just 1 tool only.
evidence_items.description: 工具种类极少，升级路径单一
evidence_items.quote_zh: 唯一一条发展得还算完整的升级路线，就是关于结构切割的那条。你从钢锯，到角磨机，再到激光炬。其他所有东西呢？只有2个甚至仅仅1个工具。

evidence_items.quote: many systems are unintuitive or frustrating
evidence_items.description: 许多系统不直观或令人沮丧
evidence_items.quote_zh: 许多系统不直观或令人沮丧

evidence_items.quote: The combat and social systems are to be gentle, a [b]mess[/b]
evidence_items.description: 战斗和社交系统一团糟
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗和社交系统说得客气点，就是一团[b]乱麻[/b]

evidence_items.quote: SFF doesn't automatically tend to your character's needs, so a several-day journey is instead broken up into chunks of skipping interspersed with desperately trying to get your characters to tend to their physical needs... upwards of ten times or more across a single trip
evidence_items.description: 快速跳过时间不会自动处理角色需求，长途旅行需反复手动照料
evidence_items.quote_zh: SFF不会自动照顾你角色的需求，所以一段数天的旅程反而被拆成一段段快进，中间夹杂着拼命试图让你的角色去满足他们的生理需求……一趟旅程下来得折腾十几次甚至更多

evidence_items.quote: the entire game is puddle deep
evidence_items.description: 游戏整体内容非常浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整个游戏浅得像水坑

evidence_items.quote: the conversation system is possibly the worst one ever created in the history of video games (just pure, dull tedium)
evidence_items.description: 对话系统极其枯燥乏味
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话系统可能是电子游戏史上创造出来的最糟糕的一个（纯粹、乏味、无聊的苦差事）

evidence_items.quote: who on earth designed the conversation and combat system like are you on crack?
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统设计糟糕。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 到底是谁设计了对话和战斗系统，你是嗑药了吗？

evidence_items.quote: building system is jank as hell
evidence_items.description: 建造系统非常粗糙。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造系统烂得要命

evidence_items.quote: who on earth designed the conversation and combat system like are you on crack?
evidence_items.description: 对话系统设计糟糕。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 到底是谁设计了对话和战斗系统，你是嗑药了吗？

evidence_items.quote: Other parts, like thrusters and sensors, offer an illusion of choice between two options, but have no real difference
evidence_items.description: 推进器和传感器等部件提供两种选择的假象，但没有实际区别。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 其他部件，比如推进器和传感器，提供了在两种选项之间做选择的假象，但并没有真正的区别

evidence_items.quote: there's only one reactor and only one drive, you're not making decisions around performance and cost and other such tradeoffs
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造缺乏实际决策，例如只有一个反应堆和一个驱动器，没有性能与成本的权衡。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只有一种反应堆和一种引擎，你并不是在围绕性能和成本以及其他这类取舍做决定

evidence_items.quote: If you're looking for some level of actual ship simulation in your spaceship building, its not here
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏真正的飞船模拟。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你在飞船建造中寻求某种程度的真实飞船模拟，这里没有

evidence_items.quote: very little that you do as a player actually matters
evidence_items.description: 玩家行为几乎没有影响，被线性推进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 作为玩家，你所做的几乎没有什么是真正重要的

evidence_items.quote: friendship and other relationship milestones don't really matter
evidence_items.description: 互动系统除了执法和雇佣价格外，友谊等关系里程碑没有意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 友谊和其他关系里程碑并不真正重要

evidence_items.quote:
i wish the over engineered mood system would be removed. 

It's trying to be the space sims, but looking at your character sleeping for hours on end is not all that fun and managing multiple crew members can be a chore. They are not that smart.
evidence_items.description: 心情系统过于复杂，管理多名船员很麻烦且AI不聪明
evidence_items.quote_zh:
我希望那套过度设计的情绪系统能被移除。

它想做成太空模拟游戏，但看着你的角色一连睡上好几个小时并不是那么有趣，而且管理多名船员可能很麻烦。他们没那么聪明。

evidence_items.quote: combat is a joke
evidence_items.description: 战斗很糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗就是个笑话

evidence_items.quote: several mechanics feel hollow and pointless
evidence_items.description: 多个机制空洞无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 好几个机制感觉空洞且毫无意义

evidence_items.quote: the social is really awkward and not adding much
evidence_items.description: 社交系统尴尬且作用不大
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交部分真的很尴尬，而且没增加多少内容

evidence_items.quote: the perks also didn't show it's importance much except for the skills
evidence_items.description: perk除了技能外重要性不明显
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了技能之外，那些特长也没有太多体现出它们的重要性

evidence_items.quote: 战斗和交互都比较单调
evidence_items.description: 战斗和交互单调
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗和交互都比较单调

evidence_items.quote: 重复性操作的太多
evidence_items.description: 重复性操作太多
evidence_items.quote_zh: 重复性操作的太多

evidence_items.quote: The enemy AI seems to be unaware when they have firearms and will not engage in combat at all.
evidence_items.description: 人员战斗缺乏挑战，安保和海盗AI不还击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 敌方AI似乎没有意识到自己持有枪械，完全不会参与战斗。

evidence_items.quote: The gameplay loop is fun, but poorly implimented.
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环实现不佳，打捞后期不再值得，赏金任务难以触及
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏循环很有趣，但实现得很糟糕。

evidence_items.quote: scrapping ships seems to be the main gameplay element in this game. Yet its boring
evidence_items.description: 打捞玩法重复无聊，缺乏变化
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拆解飞船似乎是这款游戏的主要玩法元素。但它很无聊

evidence_items.quote: your psychological needs are generally satisfied through dialogue with NPCs in a system the devs call "social combat." I'm sorry, what? This is the worst attempt at dialogue gamification since Oblivion's persuasion wheel.
evidence_items.description: 社交战斗系统难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你的心理需求通常通过与NPC的对话来满足，在一个开发者称之为“社交战斗”的系统中。对不起，什么？这是自《湮灭》的说服轮盘以来对对话游戏化最糟糕的尝试。

evidence_items.quote: There are systems in the game that are completely unused. I cannot tell you why I need to have a social life, it doesn't seem to affect anything in the game.
evidence_items.description: 社交系统完全未被使用，不影响游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏里有些系统完全没被用到。我没法告诉你为什么我需要有社交生活，它似乎对游戏里的任何东西都没有影响。

evidence_items.quote_zh:
这游戏很难评价。我喜欢这个概念。我喜欢这里面正在发生的很多东西。我玩了相当一段时间，虽然有时重复或让人强迫症发作，但并没有明显令人不快。我想，对我这种矛盾心态的高层次解释是这样的：除了玩家实际在做的事情之外，游戏非常非常热衷于机械地模拟那些在这个层面上模拟起来并不值得的东西，并且它把大部分时间和精力都花在了那上面，而不是花在能让玩家觉得值得处理的内容上。对气压和生命维持系统的关注，是在本可以更好地抽象化的东西上花费了大量细节。用一个没有内容、重复的对话系统来管理类似《模拟人生》的情绪条，真的很糟糕。打捞废弃飞船在前十几次很有趣，但确实会变得乏味重复。各种类型的任务也是如此。剧情线还算有趣，但它们只占你在游戏中可能做的事情的很小一部分。建造飞船相当粗暴，而且鉴于工具之粗糙，还挺让人头疼的。管理船员也是如此。我不知道。我不知道这游戏最初打算做成什么样，但我相当喜欢《NEO Scavenger》，所以非常期待开发者带来更多作品。我觉得那段相当长的抢先体验期，都花在从一个原本更有趣的概念上搭建所有错误的东西了。

总之。如果你想要很多钱，只要把一辆手推车装满背包，再把背包塞满肉就行了。

evidence_items.quote_zh: 基本的玩法循环几乎没有任何实际的战术决策，相反，95%的时间都是在等待计时器走完

evidence_items.quote: Then the game is only about do bad stuff like robing killing and i can't do peacefully
evidence_items.description: 游戏只允许做坏事（抢劫、杀人），无法和平游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后这游戏就只关乎干坏事，比如抢劫、杀人，我没法和平地玩

evidence_items.quote: it wouldn't give me permission to dock, and I had no idea how to let them know I was there to deliver the equipment
evidence_items.description: 到达目标船后无法获得停靠许可，也不知道如何通知对方
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它不给我停靠许可，而且我完全不知道该怎么让他们知道我是来送他们执行任务所需设备的

evidence_items.quote: the game might be a bit too easy
evidence_items.description: 游戏难度过低，生存元素缺乏威胁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏可能有点太简单了

evidence_items.quote: The base gameplay are here to test but there is no deeph to it. There will be no difference between your second (or even first if lucky) salvage run and the number 25.
evidence_items.description: 基础玩法缺乏深度，第二次打捞与第25次没有区别
evidence_items.quote_zh: 基础玩法在这里供测试，但没有任何深度。你的第二次（如果运气好，甚至第一次）打捞之旅和第25次之间不会有任何区别。

evidence_items.quote: One of the biggest issues with the game, in my mind, is the game's economy. Specifically once you get a solid grasp on the value of equipment and loose items, much of the difficulty and struggle goes away.
evidence_items.description: 一旦掌握物品价值，经济系统难度消失，缺乏挑战
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我看来，这款游戏最大的问题之一就是它的经济系统。具体来说，一旦你扎实掌握了装备和零散物品的价值，大部分难度和挣扎就消失了。

evidence_items.quote: mechanics that don't seem to do anything (such as the entire "mood" system)
evidence_items.description: 情绪系统等机制似乎没有任何作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 那些似乎什么作用都没有的机制（比如整个“心情”系统）

evidence_items.quote: 甚至格子内有物体就不能建造，还得手动移走才能建造
evidence_items.description: 格子内有物体就无法建造，必须手动移走
evidence_items.quote_zh: 甚至格子内有物体就不能建造，还得手动移走才能建造

evidence_items.quote: 不能替换墙体或者地板之类的东西，我看见好看的地板需要先手动选择把地板全拆了再建造新的，而不是直接替换地板，墙体也是一样
evidence_items.description: 不能直接替换墙体或地板，需先拆除再建造
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不能替换墙体或者地板之类的东西，我看见好看的地板需要先手动选择把地板全拆了再建造新的，而不是直接替换地板，墙体也是一样

evidence_items.quote: the gameplay loop is boring as hell
evidence_items.description: 玩法循环无聊
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏循环无聊得要命

evidence_items.quote: a more streamlined character creation method than gambling with RNG vs time management
evidence_items.description: 角色创建依赖随机数，与时间管理博弈，不够直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一种比用RNG与时间管理赌博更精简的角色创建方法

evidence_items.quote: social is spam
evidence_items.description: 社交系统只是刷屏
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交就是刷屏

evidence_items.quote: ship building is not deep
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造系统不够深入
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船建造没有深度

evidence_items.quote: combat is shallow
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗很肤浅

evidence_items.quote: If you have little tolerance for bugs, jankiness and unfinished features, you will probably have a bad time.
evidence_items.description: 游戏有未完成的功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你对bug、粗糙感和未完成的功能容忍度很低，你大概会玩得很糟心。

evidence_items.quote: the player character starts with all the 'cripplingly bad' traits by default
evidence_items.description: 默认角色带有致残特质，正面特质无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家角色默认就带有所有“严重糟糕”的特质

evidence_items.quote: the gameplay boils down to doing nothing but clicking the same 'doomscroll on social media lol' button over and over again
evidence_items.description: 社交需求只能通过重复点击同一按钮满足
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩法归根结底就是什么都不做，只是一遍又一遍地点击同一个“在社交媒体上末日刷屏 lol”按钮

evidence_items.quote: while supposedly-incredibly-rare things like reactor parts are relatively easy to find, common electronics like O2 pressure sensors are incredibly rare
evidence_items.description: 常见电子零件稀缺而稀有反应堆零件易得
evidence_items.quote_zh: 虽然像反应堆部件这种据称极其罕见的东西相对容易找到，但像氧气压力传感器这样的普通电子元件却极其稀有

evidence_items.quote: помимо разборки (и сборки) кораблей на свалке тут нечем больше занятся
evidence_items.description: 除拆装飞船外缺乏其他可玩内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了在废料场拆解（和组装）飞船之外，这里就没别的可干了

evidence_items.quote: the social combat system looks really in-depth, it's incredibly shallow, as most social actions are boilerplate
evidence_items.description: 社交战斗系统非常浅薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交战斗系统看起来非常深入，但实际上极其肤浅，因为大多数社交行动都是千篇一律的。

evidence_items.quote: most simulated systems are very shallow and simplistic
evidence_items.description: 模拟系统浅显简单，缺乏深度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数模拟系统都非常浅薄和简单化

evidence_items.quote: The social status juggling is pretty lame atm, hopefully it gets fleshed out into something more than having to do some pointless interactions every 24 hours to not be horny and sad.
evidence_items.description: 社交地位系统目前很无聊，只是每24小时进行无意义互动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前社交地位的平衡相当糟糕，希望它能被充实成比每24小时做一些毫无意义的互动来避免性欲高涨和悲伤更有内容的东西。

evidence_items.quote: The social aspect, auto task, time skip, employment system and mood structure is a bit of a nightmare and needs to be fixed up and fine tuned.
evidence_items.description: 社交、自动任务、时间跳跃、雇佣和情绪系统设计糟糕，需要修复和微调
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交方面、自动任务、时间跳跃、雇佣系统和情绪结构有点像个噩梦，需要修复和微调。

evidence_items.quote: The game provides difficulty by being tedious and every solution or enhancement so far has been very messy and half baked.
evidence_items.description: 游戏通过繁琐来提供难度，解决方案不完善
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏通过繁琐来提供难度，到目前为止每一个解决方案或增强都非常混乱且半生不熟。

evidence_items.quote: everything that can help you out once you get acclimated, like employees, med supplies and time jumps, is too sketchy and cannot be trusted by the player.
evidence_items.description: 员工、医疗用品和时间跳跃等机制不可靠，玩家无法信任
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一旦你适应之后，所有能帮到你的东西，比如雇员、医疗用品和时间跳跃，都太不可靠，玩家无法信任。

evidence_items.quote: Quests are also basic, repetitive, and super easy.
evidence_items.description: 任务基础、重复且过于简单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务也很基础、重复，而且超级简单。

evidence_items.quote: The social "combat" mechanic doesn't work well and isn't much fun.
evidence_items.description: 社交战斗机制运作不佳
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交“战斗”机制运作不佳，也不太有趣。

evidence_items.quote: The core gameplay loop (strip derelict ship for parts, sell those parts, upgrade your ship and gear) is solid, but very repetitive.
evidence_items.description: 核心玩法循环重复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 核心游戏循环（拆解废弃飞船获取零件，出售这些零件，升级你的飞船和装备）很扎实，但非常重复。

evidence_items.quote: stuff like the social interaction is more confusing than it is gameplay
evidence_items.description: 社交互动令人困惑，不像游戏玩法
evidence_items.quote_zh: 像社交互动这样的东西与其说是游戏玩法，不如说更让人困惑

evidence_items.quote: Социалка пока ощущается второстепенной системой, как и многие потребности персонажа.
evidence_items.description: 社交系统感觉次要，角色需求系统不完善
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交目前感觉是个次要系统，就像角色的许多需求一样。

evidence_items.quote: у меня персонаж набегал целый день, уже 12 часов ночи, а он даже не устал.
evidence_items.description: 角色需求增长缓慢，跑了一整天也不累
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我的角色跑了一整天，已经晚上12点了，他却一点都不累。

evidence_items.quote: and no combat to speak of
evidence_items.description: 几乎没有战斗内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 而且谈不上有什么战斗

evidence_items.quote: There is a lack of equipment / options
evidence_items.description: 缺乏装备和选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏装备/选项

evidence_items.quote: There are not enough dangers in derelicts, making them mostly loot bags.
evidence_items.description: 废弃飞船中危险不足，大多只是战利品袋
evidence_items.quote_zh: 废弃飞船里的危险不够多，让它们大多成了战利品袋。

evidence_items.quote: "spaceship combat" exists, but you have to fly to a specific location to use it.
evidence_items.description: 飞船战斗存在，但必须飞到特定地点才能使用
evidence_items.quote_zh: “飞船战斗”确实存在，但你必须飞到特定地点才能使用它。

evidence_items.quote: RPG-like traits exist but barely useful.
evidence_items.description: RPG式特质几乎没用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 类似RPG的特质存在，但几乎没什么用。

evidence_items.quote: social system is no more than just absurd.
evidence_items.description: 社交系统荒谬
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交系统简直荒谬至极。

evidence_items.quote: "atmospheric flight" is another isolated minigame.
evidence_items.description: 大气飞行是另一个孤立的小游戏
evidence_items.quote_zh: “大气层飞行”是另一个孤立的小游戏。

evidence_items.quote: Awkward combat
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统笨拙
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尴尬的战斗

evidence_items.quote: The random conversations are arbitrary, and most of the time you converse to receive a mood boost
evidence_items.description: 随机对话生硬，仅为情绪提升
evidence_items.quote_zh: 随机的对话是随意的，大多数时候你交谈是为了获得情绪提升

evidence_items.quote: missing more depth or just more things to collect and sell
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环缺乏深度，缺少可收集和出售的物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺少更多深度，或者只是缺少更多可以收集和出售的东西

evidence_items.quote: Очень странная механика "социального боя"
evidence_items.description: 社交战斗机制很奇怪
evidence_items.quote_zh: 非常奇怪的“社交战斗”机制

evidence_items.quote: it is complicated for complicated sake. It is an illusion of depth.
evidence_items.description: 游戏系统复杂但缺乏深度，为复杂而复杂
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它为了复杂而复杂。这是一种深度的假象。

evidence_items.quote: Also, a single pirate would likely be a bit more cautious than boldly walking onto a docked vessel with a crew of four gun wielding opponents.  This surely needs some balancing.
evidence_items.description: 单个海盗会大胆登上满是持枪船员的船，需要平衡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 而且，一个孤身海盗面对一艘停靠着的、船上有四名持枪对手的飞船，很可能会比大胆地走上去更谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。

evidence_items.quote: I know the punishments increase in some other places, but its easy to exploit kleg a bit.
evidence_items.description: 犯罪系统容易被利用，例如在Kleg刷惩罚
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会加重，但kleg还是有点容易被利用。

evidence_items.quote: you'll get an absurb amount of money so fast
evidence_items.description: 赚钱速度过快，导致游戏缺乏挑战
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你会很快得到一笔荒谬数量的钱

evidence_items.quote: they will bring floors ONE BY ONE
evidence_items.description: 建造时物品一次只搬运一个，效率低下
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们会把地板一块一块地搬来

evidence_items.quote: Interactions with other characters tend to be fairly limited, and relationships don’t feel especially impactful.
evidence_items.description: NPC互动有限，关系影响小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 与其他角色的互动往往相当有限，而且人际关系感觉也不是特别有影响力。

evidence_items.quote: Character creation and background systems could also use more variety.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建选项缺乏多样性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色创建和背景系统也可以增加更多多样性。

evidence_items.quote: you need to have a salvage licence just to sell items that you have ''salvaged'' from your own ship but the licence is $5000 and if you aint got that then ''♥♥♥♥ you buddy'' making you restart the game AGAIN
evidence_items.description: 出售打捞物品需要5000美元的许可证，没有钱就无法继续
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你需要有打捞许可证才能出售你从自己飞船上''打捞''来的物品，但许可证要5000美元，如果你没有，那就''去你妈的，伙计''，逼你再次重开游戏

evidence_items.quote: mental status/social/relationships seem to have no real significant impact on gameplay
evidence_items.description: 精神状态/社交/关系对游戏玩法没有显著影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 精神状态/社交/人际关系似乎对游戏玩法没有真正显著的影响

evidence_items.quote: turns out if you're suffering a nicotine withdrawl it does little to actually affect your gameplay
evidence_items.description: 尼古丁戒断对游戏玩法几乎没有影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: 事实证明，如果你正在经历尼古丁戒断，它实际上对你的游戏玩法几乎没有影响

evidence_items.quote: everyone will look to get better skills and so re-roll to get a better experience
evidence_items.description: 角色创建随机技能导致玩家倾向于反复重掷角色
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每个人都会想获得更好的技能，因此重掷角色以获得更好的体验

evidence_items.quote: There's so many stats to maintain that they coded in an Auto-play mode that does it for you!
evidence_items.description: 角色属性系统过于复杂，需要自动模式
evidence_items.quote_zh: 需要维护的属性太多了，以至于他们直接写了一个自动游玩模式来替你打理！

evidence_items.quote: The whole job system seemed so tedious compared to salavaging I don't really see the point
evidence_items.description: 工作系统相比打捞显得非常繁琐，缺乏简单工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整个工作系统相比打捞显得如此繁琐，我真看不出有什么意义

evidence_items.quote: The dialogue system is a hassle at it's current state. Too many options, too many repetitions.
evidence_items.description: 对话系统选项过多且重复，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话系统在目前状态下很麻烦。选项太多，重复太多。

evidence_items.quote: Когда понимаешь как играть и что делать геймплей становится скучным и однообразным.
evidence_items.description: 理解玩法后游戏变得无聊且重复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你明白该怎么玩、该做什么之后，玩法就变得无聊又单调了。

evidence_items.quote: Gameplay and combat are awful
evidence_items.description: 战斗体验糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩法和战斗都很糟糕

evidence_items.quote: There are a lot of (rather basic) mechanics simply missing
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺少许多基本机制
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有很多（相当基础的）机制干脆就缺失了

evidence_items.quote: the gameplay loop quickly gets stale
evidence_items.description: 游戏循环很快变得乏味
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏循环很快就变得乏味

evidence_items.quote: You constantly get pinged social requests that are unrewarding and pointless
evidence_items.description: 社交请求不断弹出且无意义、无回报，令人厌烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你会不断收到毫无回报且毫无意义的社交请求提示

evidence_items.quote: I took 2 quests the game sent my way from my contacts and o boy are they stupid
evidence_items.description: 任务设计愚蠢，例如来回跑腿或帮人找恋人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我从联系人那里接了游戏发给我的2个任务，天哪，它们真是太蠢了

evidence_items.quote: It just feels needlessly complicated and when understood, unnecessary
evidence_items.description: 社交互动和需求系统过于复杂且不必要
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它只是让人觉得毫无必要地复杂，而一旦理解了，又觉得多余

evidence_items.quote: On a fundamental level ships require a static "docking port". This just feels combersome, allow me to move it and place it how i want.
evidence_items.description: 飞船需要固定的对接端口，无法自由移动放置
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从根本上说，飞船需要一个固定的“对接端口”。这感觉太笨重了，让我能按自己的意愿移动和放置它。

evidence_items.quote: The game play itself is heavily tedious which may be expected for the start of progression, but the methods in which you try to advance your character are also fairly limited and inconsistent
evidence_items.description: 玩法繁琐，推进角色的方法有限且不一致
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏玩法本身极其繁琐，这在 progression 初期或许可以预料，但你尝试提升角色的方法也相当有限且不一致

evidence_items.quote: algunas mecánicas están mal implementadas y hacen el juego tedioso
evidence_items.description: 部分机制实现不佳，使游戏变得乏味
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些机制实现得很糟糕，让游戏变得乏味

evidence_items.quote: Игра позиционирует себя как песочница, но МАКСИМАЛЬНО отказывается ей быть - свобода действий только на словах, ВСЕ упирается в то, что нужно как придурок резать реакторы и надеяться что их скупает барыга.
evidence_items.description: 游戏自称沙盒但自由度有限，所有行动都受限于特定玩法
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏把自己定位成沙盒，但却最大限度地拒绝成为沙盒——行动自由只停留在口头上，一切都卡在你得像傻子一样去切反应堆，然后指望有贩子会收购它们。

evidence_items.quote: Где хоть какие-то альтернативные пути развития и геймплея, если игра песочница?
evidence_items.description: 缺乏替代发展路径和玩法
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果游戏是沙盒，那至少在哪里有一些替代的发展和玩法路径？

evidence_items.quote: Space is a flat 2d, and the orbital mechanics seem to be hard coded as opposed to physics driven.
evidence_items.description: 太空为平面2D，轨道力学硬编码而非物理驱动，缺乏模拟飞行体验
evidence_items.quote_zh: 太空是平面的2D，轨道力学似乎是硬编码的，而不是由物理驱动的。

evidence_items.quote: you spend an hour ripping five thrusters out of a derelict, hauling them across space, only to discover none of the scrapyards actually buy thrusters
evidence_items.description: 废品站不收购推进器，导致玩家无法出售打捞的推进器
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你花了一个小时从一艘废弃飞船里拆下五个推进器，拖着它们穿越太空，结果却发现没有一个废品回收站真的收购推进器

evidence_items.quote: combat’s a bit confusing
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统令人困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗有点令人困惑

evidence_items.quote: some of it still lacks depth
evidence_items.description: 部分机制缺乏深度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 其中一些内容仍然缺乏深度

evidence_items.quote: the loop of scavenge, sell, scavenge, expand, scavenge, sell can get a little boring
evidence_items.description: 搜刮、出售、扩张的循环会变得无聊
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拾荒、出售、拾荒、扩张、拾荒、出售的循环会变得有点无聊

evidence_items.quote: I wish there was a bit more to do with the NPCS and the stations in general
evidence_items.description: NPC和空间站缺乏可互动内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望NPC和空间站整体上能有更多可做的事

evidence_items.quote: the social mechanics feel very janky
evidence_items.description: 社交机制很生硬
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交机制感觉非常生硬

evidence_items.quote: The gameplay loop feels too dull
evidence_items.description: 玩法循环枯燥
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏循环感觉太乏味了

evidence_items.quote: none of it is properly balanced
evidence_items.description: 已实现的系统没有经过适当平衡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有一样东西的平衡是做得好的

evidence_items.quote: some things a bit lacking like social interactions
evidence_items.description: 社交互动内容有所欠缺
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些东西略显不足，比如社交互动

evidence_items.quote: There isn't a lot of component level variety that has any real impact on the finished product.
evidence_items.description: 组件种类缺乏，对最终产品没有实际影响。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有多少组件级别的多样性会对成品产生任何真正的影响。

evidence_items.quote: Combat is weird with all the pausing and unclear action/reaction stuff going on.
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统因暂停和动作/反应不明确而显得奇怪。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗很奇怪，有各种暂停以及不清楚的动作/反应之类的东西。

evidence_items.quote: Now relations with npcs are almost meaningless
evidence_items.description: 与NPC的关系几乎没有意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 现在与NPC的关系几乎毫无意义

evidence_items.quote: comes with some small text at the bottom of the contract, making sure you'll end up in financial ruin
evidence_items.description: 雇佣NPC有隐藏费用导致破产
evidence_items.quote_zh: 合同底部附带了一些小字，确保你最终会陷入财务破产

evidence_items.quote: How to bulk order tasks (maybe just daft there but there are several steps)
evidence_items.description: 批量订购任务步骤繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如何批量下达任务（也许只是我笨，但有好几个步骤）

evidence_items.quote: Derelicts don't have too much variety, and the pool of potential parts is nothing expansive.
evidence_items.description: 废弃飞船种类不多，可用零件池也不丰富
evidence_items.quote_zh: 废弃飞船没有太多变化，潜在零件的池子也毫无广度可言。

evidence_items.quote: Repairs and disassembly are just "click repair/disassemble button and wait". There's not a minigame or anything.
evidence_items.description: 修理和拆解只是点击按钮后等待，没有小游戏或操作过程，缺乏参与感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 修理和拆解就只是“点击修理/拆解按钮然后等待”。没有什么小游戏之类的。

evidence_items.quote: There's a hacking skill, but it only works on PDAs, and PDAs have almost nothing but pages of nonfunctional lore on them.
evidence_items.description: 黑客技能只能用于PDA，无法入侵终端、门或炮塔等有趣目标
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一个黑客技能，但它只对PDA有效，而PDA上几乎只有一页页无功能的背景设定。

evidence_items.quote: player NPCs dying for no reason during time speedups
evidence_items.description: 时间加速时玩家NPC无故死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在时间加速期间玩家NPC无缘无故死亡

evidence_items.quote: Every bin, crate, and locker is ridiculously small.
evidence_items.description: 每个箱子、板条箱和储物柜容量过小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每个箱子、板条箱和储物柜都小得离谱。

evidence_items.quote: The mood/emotion system was kinda wonky
evidence_items.description: 情绪系统运作不稳定
evidence_items.quote_zh: 情绪/情感系统有点不太靠谱

evidence_items.quote: this game's still searching for its core gameplay loop
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏核心玩法循环，感觉结构不完整
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏仍在寻找它的核心玩法循环

evidence_items.quote: you can expand as big as you want and there's no limit or taxes for that, which leads to all-in-one ship that can do everything. There's no real upgrade but just expand and install more equipment.
evidence_items.description: 飞船可无限扩展，没有升级或专业化设计
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可以想扩多大就扩多大，没有限制也没有相关税费，这导致出现了一艘能包办一切的全能飞船。没有真正的升级，只是扩建和安装更多设备。

evidence_items.quote: The combat isn't very exciting
evidence_items.description: 战斗不够刺激
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗不是很刺激

evidence_items.quote: the game needs more meat on its very well structured skeleton to make the player feel invested
evidence_items.description: 缺乏让玩家持续投入的内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏需要在它结构非常良好的骨架上添加更多血肉，才能让玩家感到投入

evidence_items.quote: after a while does feel super repetitive
evidence_items.description: 游戏后期感觉非常重复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩了一段时间后确实感觉超级重复

evidence_items.quote: Сломанная экономика, в начале сложно, но к середине игры ты забудешь что ты не живешь в мире где победил коммунизм, а так-то тут все за деньги.
evidence_items.description: 经济系统失衡，中期后金钱失去意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 经济系统崩坏，一开始很难，但到游戏中期你会忘记自己并不是生活在一个共产主义胜利的世界里，而这里一切都要花钱。

evidence_items.quote: Combat feels like its tacked on to the dialog system or vice versa, which is just terrible
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统感觉像是硬加到对话系统上，或反之，体验很差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗感觉像是硬塞进对话系统的，或者反过来，这简直太糟糕了

evidence_items.quote: You get 20 billion little tasks from delivering scrap to helping with corp issues, the consequences of these tasks you'll never see
evidence_items.description: 大量任务（如运送废料、处理公司问题）的后果玩家永远看不到
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从运送废料到帮助解决公司问题，你会接到200亿个小任务，而这些任务的后果你永远都看不到

evidence_items.quote: At first the game felt good, I got a pirate tracking me every 4 or so hours of game play. And then 3 in a row, and the tracking warning never stopping even after killing all of them and returning to port
evidence_items.description: 海盗遭遇频率不稳定，有时连续出现，追踪警告在击杀后仍不停止
evidence_items.quote_zh: 起初游戏感觉还不错，大约每玩4个小时就会有一个海盗追踪我。然后连续来了3个，而且即使把他们全杀了并返回港口后，追踪警告也从未停止

evidence_items.quote: when I did scrap two ships, i got back, sold my haul, and discovered I'd not scrapped the 'right stuff' because the $300 i made did not cover the $500 dollar docking fee.
evidence_items.description: 拆解飞船后未获得正确物品，收益不足以支付停靠费
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当我拆解了两艘飞船后，我回来了，卖掉了我的收获，却发现我没有拆解到“对的东西”，因为我赚的300美元还不够支付500美元的对接费。

evidence_items.quote: a lot of things are a bit finnicky
evidence_items.description: 早期版本中许多机制略显生涩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很多事情都有点棘手

evidence_items.quote: NPCs exist but any depth is only puddle deep once to enter a polycule with everyone you meet and the only thing to discuss is strange meat.
evidence_items.description: NPC 互动深度浅，只能讨论奇怪肉类。
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC是存在的，但任何深度都只有水坑那么浅，一旦和你遇到的每个人进入多人关系，唯一能讨论的就是奇怪的肉。

evidence_items.quote: ships obliterating you at high speeds homing directly at you
evidence_items.description: 敌舰高速追踪撞击玩家，摧毁玩家飞船
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船以高速直接朝你追踪而来，将你彻底摧毁

evidence_items.quote: The social mechanics are bare bones
evidence_items.description: 社交机制内容单薄
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交机制还很简陋

evidence_items.quote: combat with enemies is extremely easy if you know how to fight
evidence_items.description: 了解打法后敌人战斗过于简单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你知道怎么战斗，与敌人的战斗极其简单

evidence_items.quote: the autotask feature isn't smart enough to handle itself (it will frequently equip pressure suit without need while not equipping the pressure suit when it's actually needed, which actually can lead to your death)
evidence_items.description: 自动任务功能不智能，会错误穿脱压力服，可能导致死亡
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动任务功能不够智能，无法自行处理（它会经常在不需要的时候穿上压力服，而在真正需要的时候却不穿压力服，这实际上可能导致你死亡）

evidence_items.quote: the game is really only fully developed around one gameplay loop of one particular style of gameplay and not much else
evidence_items.description: 游戏只围绕一种玩法循环开发，其他玩法风格未充分开发
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏实际上只围绕一种特定玩法风格的一个游戏循环进行了完整开发，除此之外就没多少了

evidence_items.quote: the meat is one of several features that just feels ham-fisted in for the sake of the setting with little regard for how it actually affects gameplay in the long run
evidence_items.description: 肉感染机制设计粗糙，传播过快且难以应对
evidence_items.quote_zh: 肉块只是几个为了设定而硬塞进来的功能之一，几乎不考虑它在长期内实际如何影响玩法。

evidence_items.quote: you can't refuel, charge and pay your docking fee's from within your ship either
evidence_items.description: 无法在飞船内加油、充电或支付停靠费
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你也不能在自己的飞船里加油、充电和支付停靠费

evidence_items.quote: The Meat duplicates exponentially, advancing a few tiles in every direction every time it grows -- much faster than you can kill it because your characters get exhausted very fast when fighting. Your character won't be able to kill a single tile of meat without getting exhausted and having to step back and stand still for 5 minutes to recuperate their stamina.
evidence_items.description: 肉块以指数级速度复制，玩家角色战斗时很快力竭，无法有效清除
evidence_items.quote_zh: 肉会以指数级速度复制，每次生长都会向各个方向推进几格——远比你杀死它的速度快，因为你的角色在战斗时很快就会精疲力竭。你的角色连杀死一格肉都做不到，除非精疲力竭，然后不得不后退并原地站上5分钟来恢复体力。

evidence_items.quote: this game views someone in there late 20's  as an old man as you end up blind and deaf
evidence_items.description: 游戏将20多岁的人视为老人，导致角色失明和失聪
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏把二十多岁快三十的人当成老人，因为最后你会又瞎又聋

evidence_items.quote: большинство механик пока в едва ли рабочем состоянии
evidence_items.description: 大多数机制处于勉强可用的状态
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数机制目前还处于勉强能用的状态

evidence_items.quote: To much bureaucracy.
evidence_items.description: 官僚机制过多
evidence_items.quote_zh: 官僚作风太重了。

evidence_items.quote: there's not much to even do but build up your ship and then fly around with it
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容不足，除了造船和飞行外没什么可做的
evidence_items.quote_zh: 甚至没什么可做的，只能建造你的飞船，然后开着它到处飞

evidence_items.quote: the small transport-capacity of the char
evidence_items.description: 角色运输容量小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色那很小的运输容量

evidence_items.quote: both games are very unfinished and lack any real game play
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏实质玩法内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这两款游戏都非常不完整，缺乏任何真正的游戏玩法

evidence_items.quote: 時間以秒為單位那（几）十天直接從負債小子變成百萬富翁
evidence_items.description: 经济系统不平衡，赚钱过于容易
evidence_items.quote_zh: 時間以秒為單位那（几）十天直接從負債小子變成百萬富翁

evidence_items.quote: 人物幾乎沒有所謂成長
evidence_items.description: 人物几乎没有成长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 人物幾乎沒有所謂成長

evidence_items.quote: Fight lasted 10 seconds. You shot them three times, but got stabbed to death with a rusty shiv.
evidence_items.description: 与太空海盗的战斗仅持续10秒，射击三次后仍被生锈短刀刺死
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗持续了10秒。你朝他们开了三枪，却被一把生锈的短刀捅死了。

evidence_items.quote: the scrapping mechanics serves no other purpose than making money
evidence_items.description: 拆解机制除了赚钱外没有其他用途，缺乏深度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拆解机制除了赚钱之外没有任何其他用途

evidence_items.quote: players lack the ability to affect things in a drastic way
evidence_items.description: 玩家无法对游戏世界产生重大影响，任务和故事缺乏改变动态的作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 玩家缺乏以剧烈方式影响事物的能力

evidence_items.quote: Combat is also in the same boat. Somehow a pirate will be fine alone on a hunk of junk floating in space, no starvation/dehydration or environment exposure, who then is completely fine to try and murder you for your stuff. Except somehow it's very easy to win by just spamming a stab attack.
evidence_items.description: 战斗平衡性差，敌人行为不合理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗也是同样的情况。不知怎么的，一个海盗独自待在一块漂浮在太空中的破铜烂铁上却安然无恙，没有饥饿/脱水或环境暴露的问题，然后他完全没事地想要为了你的东西谋杀你。只不过不知怎么的，只要狂按刺击攻击就非常容易赢。

evidence_items.quote: Also, despite having a "slow metabolism" why does my character get SO hungry? Compared to thirst, hunger is RAPID. You'll need 2-3 meals before a drink of water.
evidence_items.description: 饥饿速度过快，与口渴不成比例
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另外，明明有“缓慢的新陈代谢”，为什么我的角色会这么饿？与口渴相比，饥饿感来得非常快。你得吃上2-3顿饭才能喝上一口水。

evidence_items.quote: Also needs a better social interaction system, not necessarily a complete overhaul but pretty close.
evidence_items.description: 社交互动系统需要大幅改进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 还需要一个更好的社交互动系统，不一定要彻底重做，但也差不多了。

evidence_items.quote: the police system doesnt work properly,and i dont think ever has
evidence_items.description: 警察系统无法正常工作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 警察系统无法正常工作，而且我觉得它从来就没正常过

evidence_items.quote: virtually everything except salvaging has almost not content to it currently and the systems are barely even started to be functional
evidence_items.description: 除打捞外其他玩法内容匮乏，系统功能不完整
evidence_items.quote_zh: 实际上除了打捞之外，目前几乎所有东西都几乎没有内容，而且这些系统才刚刚开始变得可用

evidence_items.quote: even building your ship is just an amount of legos, weight is not factored in, vector thrusting, atmosphere is just magic
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造缺乏深度，未考虑重量、矢量推进等物理因素
evidence_items.quote_zh: 甚至建造你的飞船也只是相当于一堆乐高积木，重量没有被考虑进去，矢量推进、大气都只是魔法

evidence_items.quote: Trying to manage your social needs that degrade so quickly
evidence_items.description: 社交需求下降过快，难以管理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 试图管理你那些下降得如此之快的社交需求

evidence_items.quote: Traits that do nothing.
evidence_items.description: 有些特质没有任何作用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 毫无作用的特质。

evidence_items.quote: Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
evidence_items.description: 有些特质或技能无法训练
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些特质或技能无法训练？

evidence_items.quote: Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
evidence_items.description: 物品和部件种类少，每艘飞船部件看起来都一样
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。

evidence_items.quote: Combat is very half baked at the moment, with a psuedo turn-based system where the real time will pause after both people have made a move.
evidence_items.description: 战斗系统半成品
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗目前非常半生不熟，采用一种伪回合制系统，双方各行动一次后实时时间就会暂停。

evidence_items.quote: Having companions doesn't work very well.
evidence_items.description: 同伴系统运作不佳
evidence_items.quote_zh: 拥有同伴的效果不太好。

evidence_items.quote: are there weird systems interactions that are counterintuitive? oh yeah.
evidence_items.description: 系统交互反直觉
evidence_items.quote_zh: 是否存在一些反直觉的奇怪系统交互？哦，确实有。

evidence_items.quote: Why is navigating the space sucks so much etc.
evidence_items.description: 太空导航体验差
evidence_items.quote_zh: 为什么太空导航这么烂等等。

evidence_items.quote: it has so many stuff going on at the same time and there is no pacing. You get bombarded by everything at the same time which is a nightmare.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容同时涌来，缺乏节奏，令人不知所措
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这游戏绝对不差，但同时发生的事情太多了，毫无节奏可言。你会在同一时间被所有东西轰炸，简直是场噩梦。

evidence_items.quote: it didnt make too much sense that I couldnt better myself after the choose-your-own-adventure character creation
evidence_items.description: 角色创建后无法提升自己，锻炼设备刚加入
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我经历了那种自选冒险式的角色创建之后，却不能提升自己，这实在不太合理。

evidence_items.quote: combat was a bit wonky
evidence_items.description: 战斗有点不稳定
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗有点别扭。

evidence_items.quote: I tried to investigate it quietly and I've tried fighting it off and was thrashed because combat is a slog
evidence_items.description: 战斗是苦差事，被击败
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我试过悄悄调查它，也试过把它打退，结果被打得很惨，因为战斗实在是一场苦战

evidence_items.quote: or are overpowered (gigs in general)
evidence_items.description: 任务系统过于强大
evidence_items.quote_zh: 或者过于强大（任务总体而言）。

evidence_items.quote: Some elements don't make sense (chargen vs gigs + natural leveling)
evidence_items.description: 角色创建与任务及自然升级系统不一致
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些元素说不通（角色创建对比任务 + 自然升级）。

evidence_items.quote: The space-sim social part of the game is broken and doesn't really work
evidence_items.description: 太空模拟社交部分损坏无法运作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的太空模拟社交部分坏掉了，而且并不真正起作用

evidence_items.quote: But man it's grindy. To get anywhere You will have to spend so many hours
evidence_items.description: 游戏极其肝，需要花费大量时间才能推进
evidence_items.quote_zh: 但天哪，这游戏太肝了。要想取得任何进展，你都得花上好多好多小时

evidence_items.quote: Socialising is instantly noticeable. The conversations are downright lunacy. There is very little agency in a conversation and it's ultimately pointless
evidence_items.description: 社交系统肤浅，对话疯狂且无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交立刻就能看出问题。对话简直是疯了。对话中几乎没有自主权，而且最终毫无意义

evidence_items.quote: it has a very hard start due to the character creation, normally either you end up with a young character with near to no skills and very bad traits OR you end up with an old better character (40-50) which then just gets problems like slow/artritis/not healthy/etc.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建导致开局困难，年轻角色技能差，年老角色有健康问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 由于角色创建，开局非常艰难，通常你要么最终得到一个几乎没有技能、特质非常糟糕的年轻角色，要么得到一个更优秀但年长的角色（40-50岁），然后就会遇到诸如迟缓/关节炎/不健康之类的问题。

evidence_items.quote: There is a crew system, but there are barely any uses for them.
